subject: Invoice cadence, PO format, and term confirmation for Atlas Therapeutics
messages:
From: Alexis Coleman <alexis@atlas-thera.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlas-thera.com
Date: 2026-08-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement here — a few items we need clarified before we can issue a PO:

- Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly invoices tied to usage, but can accept milestone invoices for larger professional services. Please confirm Redwood's flexibility.
- PO fields: our PO must include a line for SKU/plan name, start/end dates, unit price, and the following PO number format: AT-YYYY-####.
- Payment terms: Atlas requests Net 30. Would Redwood accept Net 30 on enterprise agreements?
- Discount: if we commit to a 12-month minimum committed spend, we are seeking a 20% discount off list.
- Attachments: I attached our purchase_reqs.pdf with our legal/billing contacts and tax details. We will also need a copy of the SOW and MSA to attach to the PO.

Can you confirm what you need from us and whether the above is acceptable? If there are gating finance approvals required, please advise timing — procurement hopes to issue a PO by next week.

Thanks,
Alexis Coleman
Senior Procurement Manager
Atlas Therapeutics

Attachments: purchase_reqs.pdf (1 page stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Alexis Coleman <alexis@atlas-thera.com>
Cc: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry

Hi Alexis — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was useful. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- Invoice cadence: we can do monthly usage invoices (preferred) or milestone invoices for one-time professional services. Monthly is straightforward and matches our billing system.
- PO fields: we require the PO number on the invoice and a line item that maps to the Redwood service SKU. Your AT-YYYY-#### format is fine — please include the PO number in the PO header and on each invoice.
- Payment terms: our standard enterprise terms are Net 30, but larger discounts and committed deals typically go through Finance approval. I will confirm after looping in finance.
- Discount: understood on the 20% ask for a 12-month commit. I do not want to promise that without finance approval; I'll request authorization and circle back.

What I need from you to speed this: a billing contact email (for invoice delivery) and the exact committed monthly spend range (ballpark is fine). If you can provide those, I can route this for approval today.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA.pdf (redacted stub), SOW_draft.pdf (high-level).

I will follow up with Marcus from finance and copy you on the final terms.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MSA.pdf, SOW_draft.pdf

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry — Atlas (RDW-2026-4551)

Marcus / Avery — forwarding Atlas' request. Key points:

- Customer: Atlas Therapeutics, potential 12-month committed deal (early ARR estimate: ~$240k ARR if they commit to the mid plan).
- Procurement asks: monthly invoices (OK), PO number on each invoice (required), Net 30 requested, and a 20% discount ask for a 12-month commit.
- Attachments from customer: purchase_reqs.pdf (billing contact + tax info). I attached the current SOW_draft and Redwood_MSA for reference.

Can finance approve a 15% discount as a counter (we can use that to close fast), and what are your constraints on payment terms? My recommendation: offer 15% for 12 months + Net45 to give us a little cushion on cashflow, with a clause that we review payment behavior after the first 90 days. If finance prefers Net30 we can push for team approvals.

Please advise and, if approved, sign the attached approved_discount_form so I can send a final offer to procurement today.

Thanks —
Stephanie

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry — Atlas (RDW-2026-4551)

Stephanie, Avery — reviewed. Finance position below: 

- Approved discount: finance will approve a 15% discount off list for a 12-month committed spend (requires signed SOW + PO). Please capture the committed minimum in the SOW.
- Payment terms: we can accept Net45 on the initial invoices given the discount. After 90 days of on-time payments (no more than one late payment), we will move the account to Net30. This is a standard runway clause.
- Invoice cadence: monthly usage invoices are fine. Each invoice must include the PO number and the billing contact email to be considered valid.
- Conditions: require PO number on every invoice, and a single billing email where invoices are to be sent (no multiple recipients). We will not process invoices without a valid PO number matching the AT-YYYY-#### format.

Attaching approved_discount_form.pdf (signed). Once Stephanie confirms the billing contact and committed spend, finance will generate the first invoice immediate upon activation.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: approved_discount_form.pdf

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Alexis Coleman <alexis@atlas-thera.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlas-thera.com>
Cc: procurement@atlas-thera.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry

Hi Alexis / Jordan — thanks for your patience. Finance approved the following counter-proposal (summary):

- Discount: 15% off list price for a 12-month committed term (capture committed minimum in the SOW).
- Payment terms: Net45 on invoices initially. If Atlas maintains on-time payments for the first 90 days (<=1 late payment), we will move the account to Net30.
- Invoice cadence: Monthly usage invoices (we will also support milestone invoices for PS line items).
- PO requirements: please provide PO numbers in the AT-YYYY-#### format and include the PO number on each invoice. Provide a single billing contact email (invoices@atlas-thera.com is typical).

Next steps for procurement to issue PO:
- Confirm the committed monthly spend range so we capture it in the SOW.
- Send billing contact and the exact billing address/email.
- Send PO (AT-2026-XXXX) referencing the attached SOW and Redwood MSA.

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf (please review and confirm the committed minimum), invoice_template.xlsx (how the PO/invoice fields should map), and a DocuSign link for the SOW + signature: https://docusign.com/EXAMPLE-abcdef123456

Once we have a PO number I will circulate the fully executed SOW and issue the first invoice on activation. Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf, invoice_template.xlsx

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlas-thera.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Alexis Coleman <alexis@atlas-thera.com>, procurement@atlas-thera.com
Date: 2026-08-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence, PO requirements, & discount inquiry — PO submitted

Hi Stephanie / Marcus — thanks for the clear summary. Procurement has approved the counter and we are issuing PO AT-2026-2147 for the committed 12-month term as discussed. PO will reference the attached SOW and Redwood MSA. Billing contact for invoices: invoices@atlas-thera.com.

Please confirm you received PO AT-2026-2147 and that Redwood will send the DocuSign SOW for signature. We will route the DocuSign once received.

Jordan Price
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Atlas Therapeutics

Attachment: AT-2026-2147_PO.pdf (PO stub)
